g.text: Commander Lab — Deck Repo Change Indicator Specification
Visual treatment states for local git repository status indicators on Deck cards
• Primary warning signal at a glance
• New files present not yet added
• Tokens: Uses existing :root variables (--nav-bg, --border, --text-muted, --text-heading) plus high-contrast status accents.
• Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant (> 7:1 contrast). Every state pairs color with a distinct glyph icon and aria-label.
